newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco diffs steady as focus shifts to March.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco diffs steady as focus shifts to March.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and low sulphur diesel differentials were steady on Wednesday as traders in the spot markets shifted their focus to March deliveries, traders said.
"Everyone wants to take a little breather" as trade in February deliveries wound down in the Chicago and Group Three markets, traders said.
An outage that affected a hydrodesulphurization unit processing diesel fuel at 203,700 barrel per day Jolliet, Ill., refinery was not seen as a major factor in the market, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur diesel for March deliveries was talked 7.50/7.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil, with high sulphur 5.25 cents over the print.

Group Three low sulphur diesel for March deliveries was talked 5.50/5.75 cents a gallon over the print, with high sulphur 3.75 cents over. February low sulphur diesel was talked 5.0/5.25 cents over NYMEX March heating oil.

March unleaded was bid 2.25 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded in Chicago and even with the print in Group Three, where late-February unleaded was steady at 1.75 cents over March unleaded futures.
